text: 近日，中国人民银行开展第三次证券、基金、保险公司互换便利（SFISF）操作，本次操作总额1000亿元，中标费率10bp，互换期限1年、可视情展期。光大证券积极响应政策号召，稳妥组织投标工作，成功中标本次互换便利操作。
text_en: The People's Bank of China recently conducted its third Securities, Funds and Insurance Companies Swap Facility (SFISF) operation, with a total amount of 100 billion yuan, a winning rate of 10bp, and a swap term of one year, extendable as appropriate. Everbright Securities actively responded to the policy call, prudently organized its bidding work, and successfully won bids in this swap facility operation.
